name: A King's Tribute
summary: King Magni Bronzebeard answers Sara Balloo with a lasting tribute to her fallen husband, Sully. He sends you across Ironforge with a royal commission for Grand Mason Marblesten.

sections.title: A Sovereign's Burden
sections.body: Sara Balloo's plea weighs on King Magni Bronzebeard. War's harsh needs can be hard for common folk to understand, yet every soldier beneath the Alliance banner weighs on his conscience. He cannot undo a death on the front lines. He can see that Sully Balloo's sacrifice is remembered.

sections.title: The Mason's Chisel
sections.body: King Magni chooses a stone memorial for Sully, not empty words. He entrusts you with his royal commission and sends you across Ironforge to Grand Mason Marblesten. The master stonemason receives the king's personal charge and prepares to carve the fallen defender's memory into stone.

faq.answer: Sully Balloo was a dwarven soldier who died defending the Thandol Span for the Alliance. After learning of his death, his widow, Sara Balloo, petitioned King Magni Bronzebeard.

faq.q: Why does King Magni commission a memorial?
faq.answer: King Magni bears the weight of every dwarven life lost in the Alliance's struggles. He cannot restore Sully to his widow, so he commissions a lasting monument to honor the soldier's courage.

Grand Mason Marblesten is Ironforge's master stoneworker. He is entrusted with major civic and royal building projects throughout the city, and King Magni relies on him to sculpt Sully Balloo's memorial.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You travel within Ironforge, starting at the High Seat with King Magni Bronzebeard and then going to Grand Mason Marblesten elsewhere in the capital.
Before this, you deliver Sara Balloo's heartfelt letter directly to King Magni Bronzebeard.

faq.q: Is this memorial only for Sully Balloo?
faq.answer: The tribute bears Sully Balloo's name and is meant to console his widow, Sara. It also honors every dwarven fighter who dies serving the Alliance.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see King Magni's devotion to his people. Even the lowliest dwarven foot soldier is remembered by the throne.
As an Alliance fighter, you know the fallen at the Thandol Span gave their lives guarding crucial supply lines between Khaz Modan and the northern kingdoms.
